This page doesn't exist — but the data probably still does. MetaLab was
rebuilt in 2026, and some old links changed:

- Looking for a **dataset**? They're all on the [Datasets](datasets.qmd)
  page, and every dataset can be explored interactively in
  [Visualizations](explorer.qmd).
- Looking for the **apps** (visualization, power analysis, power simulation,
  validator)? They now run right in your browser, under
  **Analyses** in the navigation bar.
- Looking for **documentation**? See [About](about.qmd), which also has the
  full changelog of what moved where.

Still stuck? [Open an issue](https://github.com/langcog/metalab/issues).
